top_signals.title: Brazil Election: Bolsonaro Says He’d Work With US, China as President
top_signals.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro said he would work with the US and China if he becomes Brazil’s president, after a surprise election performance left him poised to join a wave of conservative leaders pushing Latin America closer to Washington.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South America’s Right-Wing Shift Has Reached Brazil
top_signals.summary: Brazil’s presidential runoff is shaping up as an opportunity for the political right to cement its power across South America.
